en: Black‑and‑white view of a small rural tram or light‑rail stop in a European village. A double tram track runs diagonally along the right side of the image, with a simple level crossing across a wide dirt road. On the left and in the center are chalet‑style houses with steep roofs and wooden balconies, one bearing a small belfry or chapel‑like turret. People stand near a horse and cart, and a low wooden fence lines the tramway. Leafless trees and low wooded hills rise behind the village. There is a white roadside sign by the track and some faint writing on the building facades, but it is not clearly legible.
